_note: Research is done by a villager with the Nghiên cứu job at the Workshop; the villager's Trí tuệ must reach the tech's minInt. cost is paid when a researcher takes the order, time is seconds at speed 1. needLevel: Workshop level to start it. unlocks.recipes: recipes that become craftable; unlocks.levels: highest level a building kind may be upgraded to. recipeLevel: Workshop level each recipe needs. A recipe is craftable when the Workshop level is high enough and, if some tech unlocks it, that tech is researched. Set enabled to false to open everything.
